Primary request: carefully refine ONLY Chiikawa and Usagi in image 1 to follow the newly approved face/ear proportions of images 2 and 3. Chiikawa needs a full round lower-cheek silhouette with genuine vertical facial depth, round ears, soft curved brows, dark warm-brown rounded eyes with one upper white highlight and a tiny lower highlight, pink oval cheeks, a small compact W cat smile and tiny lip dash. Preserve the existing peeking-over-book pose, centered low face and two naturally attached white paws; do not flatten or widen the whole face. Keep ears naturally following the scene pose. Character-model coherence should be visible without making a new composition.
INVARIANTS: the accepted blue-and-white Hachiware cat on the left MUST remain visually unchanged: same rounded cheek shape, blue split fringe, dot brows, round highlighted eyes, exactly three brown hatch strokes inside each pink cheek, small closed W smile and lip dash, same paw/body/tail/pose and placement. Keep the existing green book, center binding, page marks, overlaps, hand-to-book contacts, character order, original warm brown rounded linework, gentle flat pastel/soft illustration finish and generous transparent margins. Keep the overall illustration's size and placement; no whole-scene rescaling. Do not replace the other elements, add props or characters, or change to 3D.
Output: one complete 3:2 wide illustration, 1536x1024, with real transparent alpha around the artwork. Preserve transparency; no solid white/black background, no painted checkerboard, no new glow or vignette, no text, caption, watermark, frame, or extra pupils.
